cases.explain: Моисей is the indirect object of сказал (said to whom), which takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он даже прогонит их из своей ___.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) always governs the genitive case.
завет is the direct object of заключил; an inanimate masculine noun has accusative equal to nominative.
земля is the direct object of дать; feminine nouns in -я take -ю in the accusative.
The means of the action (save with what) is expressed in the instrumental case.
The agent/means of the passive был сломлен (broken by what) stands in the instrumental case.
The preposition об (about) governs the prepositional case.
дух is the subject of был сломлен, so it takes the nominative, the dictionary form.

reading.ru: Моисей передал это израилетянам, но они не послушали его, потому что их дух был сломлен жестокой неволей.
reading.question: Why didn't the Israelites listen to Moses?
options: Their spirit was broken by cruel bondage
They did not believe in God
reading.correct: Their spirit was broken by cruel bondage
reading.explain: The text says they would not listen because their spirit was crushed by harsh slavery.

reading.question: How long did Levi live?
reading.explain: The text states that Levi lived 137 years.

reading.question: How long did Kohath live?
reading.explain: The text states that Kohath lived 133 years.

reading.ru: Аарон женился на Елизавете, дочери Аминадава и сестре Нахшона.
reading.question: Whom did Aaron marry?
reading.explain: The text says Aaron married Elisheba (Елизавета), daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon.

reading.ru: Амрам был женат на Ихаведи, сестре своего отца, которая родила ему Аарона и Моисея.
reading.question: Who were the sons of Amram and Jochebed?
reading.explain: The text says Jochebed bore Amram Aaron and Moses.

reading.ru: Это они говорили с фараоном, царем Египта, чтобы вывести израилетян из Египта.
reading.question: What was Moses and Aaron's task before Pharaoh?
options: To bring the Israelites out of Egypt
reading.correct: To bring the Israelites out of Egypt
reading.explain: They spoke to Pharaoh in order to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.
